rules.summary: In school weeks (4+ school days), 14- and 15-year-olds may work at most 3 hours on a school day, 8 on a non-school day and 18 hours a week, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. (9 p.m. June 1-Labor Day).

citation.title: N.D.C.C. § 34-07-15 — Maximum hours of labor of minors fourteen or fifteen
citation.excerpt: nor more than eighteen hours during schoolweeks, nor more than three hours on schooldays, nor more than forty hours during nonschoolweeks, nor more than eight hours on nonschooldays

rules.summary: In non-school weeks, 14- and 15-year-olds may work at most 8 hours a day and 40 a week, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. (9 p.m. June 1-Labor Day).

citation.title: N.D.C.C. § 34-07-15 — Maximum hours of labor of minors fourteen or fifteen
citation.excerpt: before the hour of seven a.m. nor after the hour of seven p.m., except that these hours are seven a.m. to nine p.m. from June first through labor day
